items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I called Linda Creed in Philadelphia and I said, “I’m working on this thing” with so-and-so... And she said, “How far are you into it?”

ctx.x: Or an artist that you didn’t really get along with.

No. There’s only been, gosh I produced my first record in 1977 and I can only think of two times, no maybe once there was an artist on Capitol in LA and I’d heard a record that she had made by a well respected at that time, very rare female producer in Philadelphia, who has passed away, Linda Creed. Great producer. And I heard this record that Linda Creed had done on this female artist. And then Capitol said they wanted me to produce an album on her. And I went out and met with her in LA, went over songs, went…
Did you ever have a significant recording done and had an investment in this session and it turns out the singer couldn’t cut it and bring in another singer?
